verses.saheeh: Woe to those who give less [than due],
verses.khattab: Woe to the defrauders
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe (waylun: a term entailing chastisement; or [it is the name of] a valley in Hell) to the defrauders:
verses.romanUrdu: Tabahi hai dandi maarne walon ke liye

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا اكۡتَالُوۡا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُوۡنَ ۖ
verses.saheeh: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
verses.khattab: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those who, when they take measure from people, demand [it] in full, the measure;
verses.romanUrdu: Jinka haal yeh hai ke jab logon se letey hai to pura pura letey hai

verses.saheeh: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
verses.khattab: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but [who] when they measure for them or weigh for them, they cause [them] loss, they diminish [for them] the measure or the weight.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab unko naap kar ya toal kar dete hai to unhein ghata dete hai

verses.saheeh: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verses.khattab: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Do such [individuals] not know for certain (alā indicates an interrogative of rebuke) that they will be resurrected
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log nahin samajhte ke ek badey din

verses.saheeh: For a tremendous Day -
verses.khattab: for a tremendous Day—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for an awful day, that is to say, on it, and this is the Day of Resurrection,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh utha kar laaye jaaney waley hain

verses.saheeh: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
verses.khattab: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a day when (yawma is a substitution for the [syntactical] locus of li-yawmin, ‘to an [awful] day’, and as such is in the accusative because of [the verb] mab‘ūthūna, ‘will be resurrected’) mankind will rise, from their graves, before the Lord of the Worlds?, [the Lord of] all creatures, for His affair, His reckoning and His requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Uss din jabke sab log Rabb-ul-Aalamin ke samney khadey hongey

verses.uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
verses.indopak: كَلَّاۤ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡفُجَّارِ لَفِىۡ سِجِّيۡنٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin
verses.saheeh: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
verses.khattab: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay!, verily, the record of the profligates, that is to say, the record of the deeds of the disbelievers, is in Sijjīn — this is said to be a book containing [the record of] all the deeds of the devils and the disbelievers; but it is also said to be a location in the lowermost part of the seventh earth, the place of Satan and his hosts.
verses.romanUrdu: Hargiz nahin, yaqeenan badkaaron ka naam-e- aamal qaid-khane ke daftar mei hai

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
verses.khattab: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And what would tell you what Sijjīn is?, what the book of Sijjīn is.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhey kya maloom ke woh qaid-khaney ka daftar kya hai

verses.saheeh: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
verses.khattab: a fate ˹already˺ sealed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[It is] a sealed book.
verses.romanUrdu: Ek kitaab hai likhi hui

verses.saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe to the deniers on that day,
verses.romanUrdu: Tabahi hai us roz jhutlane walon ke liye

verses.saheeh: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
verses.khattab: those who deny Judgment Day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who deny the Day of Judgement, [the Day of] Requital (alladhīna yukadhdhibūna bi-yawmi’l-dīn: either a substitution for or an explication of al-mukadhdhibīna, ‘the deniers’);
verses.romanUrdu: Jo roz-e-jaza ko jhutlatay hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهٖۤ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ اَثِيۡمٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu mu'tadin atheemin
verses.saheeh: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
verses.khattab: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and none deny it but every sinful (the form [athīm] is hyperbolic) transgressor, overstepping the bounds.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usey nahin jhutlata magar har woh shaks jo hadd se guzar janey wala bad-amal hai

verses.uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: اِذَا تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.saheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
verses.khattab: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When Our signs, [of] the Qur'an, are recited to him, he says, ‘[Mere] fables (asātīr) of the ancients!’, [mere] tales that were written down (sutirat) in ancient times (asātīr is the plural of ustūra or istāra).
verses.romanUrdu: Usey jab hamari ayaat sunayi jaati hain to kehta hai yeh to agley waqton ki kahaniyan hai

verses.uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.indopak: كَلَّا بَلۡ رَانَ عَلٰى قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: kalla bal rana 'ala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona
verses.saheeh: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
verses.khattab: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit
verses.jalalayn: ﻿No indeed! — a deterrent and a warning against saying such [things]. Rather there has slayed, engulfed, their hearts, covering them like rust that which they earned, of acts of disobedience.
verses.romanUrdu: Hargiz nahin, balke darasal in logon ke dilon par inke burey aamal ka zang(rust) chadh gaya hai

verses.uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.indopak: كَلَّاۤ اِنَّهُمۡ عَنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لَّمَحۡجُوۡبُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.saheeh: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
verses.khattab: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay!, verily, they, on that day, the Day of Resurrection, will be screened off from their Lord, and so they will not see Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Hargiz nahin bil yaqeen us roz yeh apne Rubb ki deed(deedar) se mehroom rakhey jayenge

verses.saheeh: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
verses.khattab: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then they will be exposed to Hell-fire, [then] they will enter the scorching Fire;
verses.romanUrdu: Phir yeh jahannum mein jaa padenge

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.saheeh: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
verses.khattab: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then it will be said, to them: ‘This, that is, the chastisement, is that which you used to deny!’
verses.romanUrdu: Phir insey kaha jayega ke yeh wahi cheez hai jisey tum jhutlaya karte thay

verses.uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.indopak: كَلَّاۤ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ لَفِىۡ عِلِّيِّيۡنَ ؕ
verses.saheeh: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyin.
verses.khattab: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay!, verily, the record of the pious, that is, the record of the deeds of the believers who were sincere in their faith, is in ‘Illiyyūn — this is said to be the book [containing] all the good deeds of the angels and the believers from among the two heavy ones [sc. mankind and jinn]; but it is also said to be a place below the Throne in the seventh heaven;
verses.romanUrdu: Hargiz nahin, beshak neik aadmion ka naam-e-aamal buland paya logon ke daftar mein hai

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
verses.khattab: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and what will tell you, [what will] inform you, what ‘Illiyyūn is?, what the book of ‘Illiyyūn is.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhein kya khabar ke kya hai woh buland paya logon ka daftar

verses.saheeh: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.khattab: a fate ˹already˺ sealed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[It is] a sealed book,
verses.romanUrdu: Ek likhi hui kitaab hai

verses.saheeh: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
verses.khattab: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿witnessed by those brought near, from among the angels.
verses.romanUrdu: Jiski nigeh-daasht muqarrab farishtay karte hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.khattab: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly the pious will be amid bliss, [in] Paradise,
verses.romanUrdu: Beshak neik log badey mazey mein hongey

verses.saheeh: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.khattab: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around
verses.jalalayn: ﻿upon couches, [upon] beds beneath canopies, gazing, at the bliss which they have been given.
verses.romanUrdu: Unchi masnadon(couches) par baithay nazarey kar rahey hongey

verses.saheeh: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
verses.khattab: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight
verses.jalalayn: ﻿You will perceive in their faces the radiancy of bliss, the splendour and beauty of blissfulness,
verses.romanUrdu: Unke chehron par tum khushhaali ki raunak mehsoos karogey

verses.saheeh: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
verses.khattab: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as they are given to drink a nectar, a wine free of any impurities, [that is] sealed, in its vessel, none other than them breaking its seal,
verses.romanUrdu: Unko nafees tareen sarband sharaab pilayi jayegi jispar mushk ki mohar(seal) lagi hogi

wbw.translation: They will be given to drink

verses.uthmani: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.indopak: خِتٰمُهٗ مِسۡكٌ ؕ وَفِىۡ ذٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ الۡمُتَنــَافِسُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.saheeh: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
verses.khattab: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿whose seal is musk, that is, whose final sip is followed by an emanating scent of musk — so for such [bliss] let the viers vie, let them desire to apply themselves to obedience of God —
verses.romanUrdu: Jo log dusron par baazi le jana chahtey hon woh is cheez ko haasil karne mei baazi le jane ki koshish karein

verses.saheeh: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
verses.khattab: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and whose mixture, that is to say, that with which it is mixed, is of Tasnīm, which is explained by His [following] words:
verses.romanUrdu: Us sharaab mei tasneem ki aamezish(mixture) hogi

verses.saheeh: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
verses.khattab: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a spring (‘aynan is in the accusative because of an implicit [prefatory] amdahu, ‘I extol [this spring]’) from which those brought near will drink (yashrabu bihā: [should be yashrabu] minhā, or [it may be that bihā is used because] yashrabu is meant to imply the sense of yaltadhdhu [bihā, ‘in which they delight’]).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek chasma hai jiske paani ke saath muqarrab log sharaab piyengey

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡا كَانُوۡا مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ ۖ
verses.transliteration: inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily the guilty, like Abū Jahl and his ilk, used to laugh at the believers, such as ‘Ammār [b. Yāsir] and Bilāl [the Ethiopian] and those like them, in mockery of them;
verses.romanUrdu: Mujrim log duniya mein imaan laane walon ka mazaak udate thay

verses.saheeh: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
verses.khattab: wink to one another whenever they passed by
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when they, the believers, passed them by, they would wink at one another, the guilty beckoned with their eyebrows and eyelids towards the believers in mockery;
verses.romanUrdu: Jab unke paas se guzarte to aankhein maar maar kar unki taraf isharey karte thay

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡۤا اِلٰٓى اَهۡلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوۡا فَكِهِيۡنَ ۖ
verses.transliteration: waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena
verses.saheeh: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
verses.khattab: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when they returned to their folks they would return blithely (fākihīna: a variant reading has fakihīna), rejoicing in their [disparaging] mention of the believers;
verses.romanUrdu: Apne gharon ki taraf palat-tey to mazey letey huey palat-tey thay

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ لَـضَآلُّوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona
verses.saheeh: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
verses.khattab: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when they see them, that is, the believers, they say, ‘Lo! these [men] are astray!’, on account of their belief in Muhammad (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab unhein dekhte to kehte thay ke yeh behke huey log hain

verses.saheeh: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
verses.khattab: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Yet they, that is, the disbelievers, were not sent as watchers over them, [over] the believers, to preserve them or [to keep a record of] their deeds and thus guide them back to what is best for them.
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke woh un par nigran banakar nahin bhejey gaye thay

verses.uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَالۡيَوۡمَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنَ الۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.saheeh: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
verses.khattab: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So today, that is, the Day of Resurrection, the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj imaan laane waley kuffar par hans rahay hai

verses.saheeh: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.khattab: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on
verses.jalalayn: ﻿upon couches, in Paradise, gazing, out from their dwellings at the disbelievers while they are being tortured; and they will laugh at them just as they, the disbelievers, had laughed at them in the world.
verses.romanUrdu: Masnadon par baithey huey unka haal dekh rahey hain

verses.uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.indopak: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ الۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yaf'aloona
verses.saheeh: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
verses.khattab: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have the disbelievers been requited for what they used to do? Yes, indeed!
verses.romanUrdu: Mil gaya na kafiron ko un harkaton ka sawab jo woh kiya karte thay
